name: After recital A
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 16 October 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2429 as regards origin labelling for fruit and vegetables originating in the non-self-governing territory of Western Sahara
part_text: Aa. whereas the negotiation and conclusion of the amendment to the EU-Morocco Euro-Mediterranean Association Agreement lacked transparency; whereas its provisional application bypassed the European Parliament and disregarded its explicit request not to provisionally apply trade agreements before its consent; whereas the proposed delegated regulation has been proposed before Parliament could give its consent to the amendment to the agreement;
